sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمّ مَع الْمُدِير بُكْرَة
raw: عندي meeting مهم مع المدير بكرة
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtinɡ muˈhimm ˈmaʕ almuˈdiːr ˈbukra
gloss_en: I have an important meeting with the manager tomorrow
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ], /iː/; default pan-Arabic table Watson2002/Holes2004). Omani sedentary frame keeps /q/ and unaffricated /k/ (albalushi2016).

gloss_en: I must finish the report before noon
notes: [work] report→ribuːrt (/p/→[b], default table). qabl keeps /q/ (albalushi2016 Muscat sedentary); ظ retained /ðˤ/ (albalushi2016 p.87).

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imeːl (/eɪ/→[eː], OM declares /eː/). default table.

sentence: laptop تَبَعِي فِيه خَلَل فِي wifi
raw: laptop تبعي فيه خلل في wifi
ipa: labtub ˈtabaʕiː ˈfiːh ˈxalal fiː wifi
gloss_en: my laptop has a fault in the wifi
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], coda cluster); wifi→wifi (all segments native). default table. matrix keeps plain /k/... n/a; no /ki/ affrication triggered.

gloss_en: I have an appointment at the doctor now
notes: [work] appointment→abuintmint (/p/→[b]); al-ḥīn 'now' (Gulf/Omani). default table.

gloss_en: we'll go to the mall on the weekend
notes: [daily] mall→mal; weekend→wiːkind. b-imperfect future ban-rūḥ; default table.

gloss_en: download the file and do an update
notes: [tech] file→fil; update→abdat (/p/→[b]). imperatives ḥammil / sawwi (Omani sawwā 'do'). default table.

sentence: delivery بِيُوصَل بُكْرَة وْ الدَّفْع cash
raw: delivery بيوصل بكرة و الدفع cash
ipa: dilifari biˈjuːsˤɑl ˈbukra w adˈdafʕ kaʃ
gloss_en: delivery arrives tomorrow and payment is cash
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari (/v/→[f]); cash→kaʃ. default table.

gloss_en: the manager said the project is good
notes: [work] manager→manadʒar (/dʒ/ kept, not Cairene [ɡ]); project→brudʒikt (/p/→[b], /dʒ/ kept). qāl keeps /q/, zayn keeps diphthong ay (albalushi2016). default table.

gloss_en: I saw the video online
notes: [daily] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]); online→unlin. default table.

sentence: لَازِم أَحْجِز ticket وْ flight بَدْرِي
raw: لازم أحجز ticket و flight بدري
ipa: ˈlaːzim ˈʔaħdʒiz tikit w flajt ˈbadriː
gloss_en: I must book the ticket and flight early
notes: [travel] ticket→tikit; flight→flajt (/aɪ/→[aj], diphthong retained). default table.

sentence: offer زَين بَس service مُو زَين
raw: offer زين بس service مو زين
ipa: ufar ˈzajn ˈbas sarfis ˈmuː ˈzajn
gloss_en: the offer is good but the service is not good
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; service→sarfis (/v/→[f], /ɪ/→[i]). mū negator, bas 'only', zayn 'good' (albalushi2016 register). default table.

gloss_en: my mobile doesn't work
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan mobile→[moːbaːjil] (Gulf/Omani realisation with mid [oː]; Holes2004). Pipeline reads و as [uː]→almuˈːbaːjil (over-length ˈː artifact, WRONG); correct value pinned by hand. mā ... yishtiġil.

gloss_en: I saw the news on the television
notes: [daily] Arabic-script loan television→tilifizjuːn; sun-assimilated article at-t→[tt] (ت is a sun letter). Pipeline output matches the attested realisation → pinned.

gloss_en: the car has a puncture we must fix
notes: [automotive] Arabic-script loan banšar 'tyre puncture' (<Eng. puncture; Gulf loan, Holes2004)→[banʃar]. Pipeline matches attested → pinned.

gloss_en: this car is automatic, not manual
notes: [automotive] Arabic-script loan automatic→[ʔotomaːtik] (attested Gulf realisation, mid [o]). Pipeline over-lengthens & reads او/و as [uː]→ʔuːtuːmaˈːtiːk (WRONG); correct value pinned by hand. mū 'not'.

gloss_en: let me pay cash, it's better
notes: [commerce] Arabic-script loan cash→[kaːʃ]. Pipeline matches attested → pinned.

gloss_en: how are you today? hope you're well
notes: [greeting] Omani Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع. Spells كَيف حَالَك الْيَوم؟ عَسَاك زَين (ʕasāk 'hope you're', diphthongs ay/aw retained; albalushi2016). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived from the Arabic it spells.

sentence: wein re7t ams? ma re7t wala mkan
raw: wein re7t ams? ma re7t wala mkan
ipa: ˈwajn ˈriħt ˈʔams ˈmaː ˈriħt ˈwalaː maˈkaːn
gloss_en: where did you go yesterday? I didn't go anywhere
notes: [daily] Omani Arabizi: 7=ح. wein=wayn — Muscat sedentary keeps /aj/, does NOT monophthongise to wēn (albalushi2016). Spells وَين رِحْت أَمْس؟ مَا رِحْت وَلَا مَكَان. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; hand-derived.

gloss_en: I have an appointment at seven
notes: [daily] Omani Arabizi: 3=ع. Spells عِنْدِي مَوعِد السَّاعَة سَبْعَة (mawʕid keeps diphthong aw; sun-assim as-sāʕa; albalushi2016). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; hand-derived.
